caption: The drawing features four ornate, vertically oriented decorative objects arranged in a loose cross pattern against a plain, cream-colored background. The top object is composed of overlapping oak leaves and clusters of acorns, all rendered in shades of brown, gold, and muted green. The left object has a richly ornamented, elongated shape with a blue background at the top, adorned with gold floral patterns and oval motifs, blending into a gold and green stem. The right object is also elongated and features an embossed design of leaves and berries, predominantly colored in gold with greenish shading and some brown accents. The bottom object depicts a cluster of stylized leaves and round fruits or nuts, with small floral elements, rendered in tones of gold, brown, and green. All objects are detailed and exhibit a metallic or painted ornamental finish.
title: Tie-back
